releases.name: v3.0.0 — plugin, overrides, selective session sync
releases.body:
Complete rewrite. The published scripts had fallen four months behind the version in daily use, and the whole-database session sync they shipped stops being viable once `opencode.db` passes a gigabyte.

`npm install -g opencode-github-sync`

## Highlights

**OpenCode plugin.** Startup pull, optional push on idle, and an `opencode_sync` tool. The CLI stays, because a plugin cannot repair the configuration that stops the plugin from loading.

**Per-machine overrides.** `opencode-sync.overrides.jsonc` is merged into the config after a pull and subtracted again before a push, using `git show HEAD:` as the baseline rather than the working copy. An overridden key is invisible to sync in both directions, and the machine keeps its own settings throughout.

**Selective session sync.** Sessions export individually as gzipped JSON shards, chosen by time window, include list, project directory and per-session size cap. Different sessions are different files, so git merges them unaided; the same session edited twice resolves by `time_updated`. Import is a transactional upsert.

**One-command setup.** `opencode-sync init` creates the private repository and configures the machine through the GitHub CLI.

## Correctness

- Pushes are verified by reading the remote head back — `git push` can exit zero without the remote moving.
- Symlinks and Windows junctions are refused rather than followed.
- File and directory replacements are atomic.
- A cross-process lock covers the plugin, the CLI and every OpenCode window.
- Line endings pinned to LF; `text=auto` alone rewrote skill shell scripts to CRLF on Windows.
- Commit messages use a stable pseudonym, so a corporate asset-tag hostname cannot reach the repository.
- Credentials are opt-in and refused on public repositories.

## Breaking changes

Session sync no longer commits the database, and Git LFS is no longer used. The shell and `.cmd` wrappers are replaced by a real `bin` entry — install from npm instead of copying scripts.

Full notes in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/doomsday616/opencode-github-sync/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

releases.name: v2.1.0 — Tokyo Night UI + Bug Fixes
releases.body:
## What's New in v2.0 → v2.1

### 🎨 Complete UI Redesign — Tokyo Night Theme

The entire CLI has been redesigned with a Tokyo Night color palette using **true color RGB** and ANSI 256:

- **No-box header**: `OpenCode Sync — ⚡ Push to GitHub` (clean, no border)
- **Force mode** shown inline as `⚠ FORCE` in red
- **Interactive menu** via `@inquirer/select` with `○/●` circle indicators and cyan `rgb(92,156,245)` highlight
- **Braille spinner** (⠋⠙⠹...) during sync operations, clears on first real output
- **Step-by-step streaming output**: Each phase appears as it completes with file-level detail
- **Completion banner**: Cyan `━━━━━` separator + green `✨ 同步完成！` + descriptive slate text on the same line

### 📝 Chinese UI Text

All user-facing text is now in Chinese. Git terminology (Push, Pull, Fetch, Stash, Rebase, Commit, Reset) is kept in English for clarity.

### 🧭 4-Option Interactive Menu

```
? 你想同步什么？
❯ ● 仅配置
  ○ 仅会话
  ○ 全部
  ○ 退出
```

After selection, the full menu is redrawn with the selected item highlighted in cyan `●` and others dimmed in gray `○`.

### 🚀 Bootstrap Launcher

`opencode-launcher.js` sits between wrapper scripts and the sync core:

- **Self-update**: Fetches remote and updates `scripts/` if changed
- **Dependency bootstrap**: Auto-installs `@inquirer/select` when needed
- **Delegation**: All arguments pass through transparently

### 🐛 Bug Fixes (v2.1)

- **Fix data loss on pull when already up-to-date** — `doPull` previously called `stageOut` even when no remote changes existed, which ran `rmDirRecursive` on local directories and deleted files not yet pushed. Now `stageOut` is only called when there are actual incoming changes.
- **Fix banner accuracy** — Banner is now printed by the child scripts (sync-config/sync-sessions) instead of dispatch, so "已是最新" shows `upToDateBanner` and actual syncs show `completionBanner`.
- **Fix `--target` label propagation** — When running "both", each child script gets its own `--target=config` / `--target=sessions` for accurate banner text.
- **Add `SYNC_CONFIG_ROOT` / `SYNC_DATA_ROOT` env overrides to sync-sessions.js** — Previously only sync-config.js supported these; now both are consistent.
- **Add `skipLfs()` to sync-sessions.js** — Matches sync-config.js behavior.
- **Fix color inconsistency** — `c.gray` → `c.tn.gray` throughout.
- **Fix English messages in sync-sessions.js** — `initRepo` step messages changed to Chinese.

### 🧪 Test Suite (v2.1)

New `tests/test-sync-logic.js` with **34 integration tests** covering:
- Push with changes / no changes
- Pull with incoming / no changes
- BUG1 regression: local new files preserved on pull-no-changes
- stageOut called correctly on pull-with-changes
- Banner target label accuracy (`config` / `sessions` / `both`)
- No double banner from dispatch

### 🎨 Color Reference

| Element | Color | Code |
|---------|-------|------|
| Titles, accents, selected item, separator | Blue/cyan | `rgb(92,156,245)` |
| "同步完成！" text | Green | `rgb(0,210,106)` |
| Success checkmark | ✅ emoji | — |
| Warnings | Yellow | `#e0af68` (ANSI 179) |
| Errors, FORCE tag | Red | `#f7768e` (ANSI 204) |
| ⚡ icon | Purple | `#9d7cd8` (ANSI 140) |
| Borders, dim, unselected | Gray | `#565f89` (ANSI 60) |
| Body text | Text | `#a9b1d6` (ANSI 146) |
| Banner description | Slate | `#94a3b8` (ANSI 103) |

### Terminal Output

```
  OpenCode Sync — ⚡ Push to GitHub  ⚠ FORCE

? 你想同步什么？
  ❯ ● 仅配置
    ○ 仅会话
    ○ 全部
    ○ 退出

  ✅  正在从 4 个目录暂存文件...  📝~5
       ~ _state/frecency.json
       ~ _state/kv.json
       + _agents/new-skill/SKILL.md
  ✅  已提交：5 个文件变更
  ✅  已 Push 到 GitHub repo（rebase，无冲突）

  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  ✨ 同步完成！  配置文件已成功 Push
```

### 📦 File Inventory

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `scripts/ui.js` | Shared UI — Tokyo Night RGB colors, logo, banners, formatStats |
| `scripts/opencode-sync-core.js` | Menu, streaming runner, dispatch |
| `scripts/sync-config.js` | Config push/pull with step-by-step outpu

releases.name: v1.0.0 — Initial Release
releases.body:
Cross-device OpenCode config & session sync via a private GitHub repository.

## What's included

- **3 core scripts** — `opencode-sync-core.js`, `sync-config.js`, `sync-sessions.js`
- **8 wrapper commands** — 4 for macOS/Linux, 4 for Windows (.cmd)
- **Bilingual docs** — English + 中文

## Features

- Sync 4 directories (config, data, state, agents/skills) into one git repo
- Interactive mode: choose config / sessions / both
- Force push/pull for conflict resolution
- Git LFS for large SQLite databases
- SQLite safe backup via `.backup` command
- Migration auto-repair across different OpenCode versions
- Auto-stash local changes during pull

## Getting started

1. Clone this repo
2. Copy scripts to `~/.config/opencode/scripts/`
3. Install wrappers to `~/.local/bin/`
4. Set `SYNC_REMOTE_URL` env var to your private GitHub repo
5. Run `opencode-push` or `opencode-pull`
